title: Eureka
description: A Minecraft Resource pack for Hypixel Skyblock with a strong focus on innovation.
body:
# Required Dependencies
The latest release of this Resource Pack requires [Catharsis v1.0.0-beta.17](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis/versions) or newer to function properly!
## Description
A heavy-in-development Resource Pack for Hypixel Skyblock, powered by [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)!
## Currently implemented features
### Configs
Eureka makes use of Catharsis to add config options, allowing you to use alternate versions of existing features or toggling them.
### Items
Currently rod part overlays override any custom rod textures, and in the future they'll be adapted to strictly be compatible with the official Hypixel Skyblock Resource Pack.
- Hook/Line/Sinker Rod Part overlays for Fishing Rods.
### Blocks
I'm pretty sure that Mithril isn't actually made of wool?
- Custom block textures for Pure Iron, Gold, Redstone and Diamond, with "Spent" variants after mining them.
- Jade integrations to show information from /handyblockguide for every custom block in it.
### Prop Models
Multi-block structures are completely uncharted territory when it comes to Hypixel Skyblock resource packs, existing models include:
- Dark Monoliths in the Dwarven Mines
- Blood Effigies In the Rift
- Auction House Banners in the Hub
- File pillars for inferno Demonlords
### GUI Overhaul
As it stands, a fully vanilla GUI looks a bit boring... let's spice things up!
- A (WIP) Perk Tree for the Heart of the Mountain menu.
- Custom Mobtype and Player Stat Icons (Both 16x and 8x).
- Rarity-based item tooltips.
- a (WIP) Custom quick-travel menu using the map in the Skyblock Hub.
- "Seamless filler", which turns Black Stained Glass Panes in whatever menus into something that looks more like the defalt inventory, also has a "hide" mode for transparent GUI packs. 
### Entities
So many mobs yet they all have the same base model, ugh.
- Custom Entity Models for Emerald Slimes, Rain Slimes, Toxic Rain Slimes, Sludge and Bayou Sludge.
- There also is one for Goldor in a very rough state!
### Qol
Just to make some asks a little easier.
- Brewing guide visible in brewing stand GUIs.
### Accessibility
Because everyone should have a fair experience.
- Toggleable expansion to the built-in Vanilla High Contrast GUI, now covering more GUIs, HUD elements and modded GUIs.
### Miscellaneous
Some other little quirks that aren't part of a main category.
- Pack cover that changes based on whether pack is loaded or not.
### Support & Bugs
If you ever run into any issues with the pack, feel free to ask for support and report bugs on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/8W53hjhFHg) and [Github Issues](https://github.com/meowdding/eureka-pack/issues) respectively!
## Heads up!
In Alpha v0.0.4-v0.0.6, tooltip separators are broken, which lead to them being disabled by default.

To those who occasionally point it out, I'm aware that Sigma actually developed to be an S in Latin script, I just thought that it looked cool as an E :3
